Box.description: Rectangle in output pixels of the 1080x1920 frame.
Box.title: Box

CaptionLayer.description: A second caption language drawn in the same safe band as the primary.
CaptionLayer.title: CaptionLayer

CatalogId.description: Registry id of a catalog item. Validated by registry lookup.

CharacterAnchors.description:
Feet points of a three by three grid over the visual area.

The unprefixed points are the bottom row that saved scenes use. A template
written before the upper rows existed leaves those points empty, and an
empty point is drawn at the same column of the bottom row.
CharacterAnchors.title: CharacterAnchors

CharacterSpec.description: Concrete part combination. Null when character_role is none.
CharacterSpec.title: CharacterSpec

CsrfResponse.description: Same-origin re-issue for a reloaded tab; the client keeps it in memory.
CsrfResponse.title: CsrfResponse

EntityId.description: App-issued id. Prefix p project, v video, s scene, l line, e element, c change, j job, a artifact, u upload, ps preset, rf reference.

FormatCard.description:
Data file core/app/catalog/format_cards/<id>.json.

fills are card values; recommends never overwrite user values.
FormatCard.title: FormatCard

KeySound.description: One key press of a typing sound entry.
KeySound.title: KeySound

LineText.description: One line's text in a second caption language.
LineText.title: LineText

Origin.description: Where a value came from. Precedence: user > reference > preset > card > llm > default.
Origin.title: Origin

PackageStatus.description: Generated packages move draft -> validated -> ready. Only ready is listed.
PackageStatus.title: PackageStatus

Palette.description: Theme colours. The five required keys are fixed; up to 11 extra keys are allowed.
Palette.title: Palette

PlacementAnchor.description:
Feet point of the character on a three by three grid over the visual area.

The unprefixed values are the bottom row that saved scenes use. The middle
and top prefixes lift the character above that row.
PlacementAnchor.title: PlacementAnchor

PresetCaption.description: Primary caption a preset stores. The extra language layer is not saved.
PresetCaption.title: PresetCaption

PresetSettings.description: Settings saved in a preset. Language, length, topic, script and results are not saved.
PresetSettings.title: PresetSettings

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details plus the app extension members.
Problem.title: Problem

Provenance.description: Generated package origin. Never contains prompts, URLs or user text.
Provenance.title: Provenance

ReferenceSummary.description: Kept after the source file is deleted. Holds no URL, no frames and no transcript.
ReferenceSummary.title: ReferenceSummary

Regions.description: caption must stay inside the vertical safe area checked by the registry validator.
Regions.title: Regions

RelPath.description: Relative path inside a package or data root. No absolute path, no parent segment, no backslash.

SemanticCode.description: Codes returned in the errors member of a problem body (CONTRACTS 1.3).
SemanticCode.title: SemanticCode

SfxEntry.description: One effect sound. A typing kind here is a legacy document, not a new cue.
SfxEntry.title: SfxEntry

TypingSoundEntry.description:
A set of key presses for typewriter captions. The ``keys`` member is the
discriminator that keeps legacy ``SfxEntry`` manifests readable.
TypingSoundEntry.title: TypingSoundEntry

VideoBuild.description: Derived view, never persisted. Computed from cache keys and the artifact index.
VideoBuild.title: VideoBuild

app__schemas__api__Capabilities.description: Offline scope. open/edit/play work offline; generation needs the listed items.
app__schemas__api__Capabilities.title: Capabilities
